content: MK says that in late Timurid Iran Naqshbandi ascendancy, through Jāmī's revisionism in particular, partially obscured Ibn Turka's legacy, though the lettrist and occultist writings of the Kāshifīs, father and son, counteracted this.
refers_to_primary: Jāmī; Ḥusayn Vāʿiẓ Kāshifī; ʿAlī Ṣafī Kāshifī
